limitations: Procurement notices provide commercial context, not evidence that a payment occurred.

Find a Tender extension URLs are retained, but their moving schema targets are not yet frozen; this fixture release parses only the explicitly registered fields above.
The source registry pins exact bytes from mutable live APIs; retain the ignored local captures until durable archive URLs with matching bytes are registered.
